testName: DreamHouse: Schedule Broker Tour & Property Day Assignment
steps:
1. Open Property record "Victorian Modern Retreat"
2. Locate "Schedule Tour" quick action button in highlights panel
3. Click on "Schedule Tour"
4. In popup modal, select Target Tour Date as next Saturday 10:00 AM
5. In Assigned Broker lookup, select "Caroline Kingsley"
6. Enter Prospect Name "Alexander Wright" and Email "a.wright@example.com"
7. Click on "Confirm Tour Booking" button
8. Verify success toast "Tour booked successfully with Caroline Kingsley"
9. Verify Tour appointment is logged in Property Activity Timeline
